safetyRationale: XNBUA uses the exact prototype shore neutral for BUAARE area fills only; land, built-up areas and water remain distinct. CHBRN and all hazard uses are unchanged. XNGEO applies prototype chart-text ink only to OBJNAM in the 18 pinned BUAARE/LNDARE/LNDRGN/SEAARE lookup records; other label attributes and all navigational feature labels remain unchanged. The HTML defines no complete ENC depth-area palette. Explicit additional shades retain the pinned deep/medium/shallow/very-shallow/intertidal distinctions; safety contour and safety soundings remain distinct. Day CHBLK/CHGRD retain pinned dark ink for shallow-area contrast. Dusk uses prototype floating text and Night uses prototype chart text for general monochrome ink. Baked Dusk/Night sheets change only pixels matching Day neutral ink, reviewed theme neutral RGB and identical alpha (42100 pixels each). All other pixels, symbol geometry, lookups, chromatic buoy/light roles and conditional symbology are unchanged. Native real-ENC hazard review is mandatory before acceptance.
